decision.question: Was the specific black DVD in the source image transformed into a visibly white DVD in the edited image?
decision.criteria: Pass only if the source black DVD can be matched to an edited object and that same object is visibly white while remaining identifiable as a DVD. Fail if the source DVD is confidently matched and remains black, or is confidently shown not to have been transformed into a white DVD. Unknown if the source DVD's identity or correspondence to an edited object cannot be established.
decision.binding: Compare the small rectangular item near the center of the source with both edited white discs. Weigh position, shape, and surrounding scene context together; do not assume either disc is the source DVD based on whiteness or location alone. Judge only whether the requested transformation is established, not whether some unrelated white disc appeared. Reserve unknown for genuinely unresolved source identity or correspondence.
